Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class PdfReportGenerator

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.AbstractReportGenerator<PdfCanvas>
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.PdfReportGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ReportGenerator
public class PdfReportGenerator extends AbstractReportGenerator<PdfCanvas>
A concrete class of the Template Method pattern that draws the one-page PDF report: a header, then active versus idle time, the frequency of compilation errors, and the class and method timeline, each as a table and a chart.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh
